summary: Ceragon Networks filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, reporting its first quarter financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes revenue of $85.0 million, GAAP operating income of $2.1 million, GAAP net loss of $1.3 million, and EPS of ($0.01). The company reiterated its 2026 guidance of $355-385 million revenue and non-GAAP operating margin of 6.5%-7.5%. No special situation event is present. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US earnings press release under Form 8-K Item 2.02.
